intro.zh: 涵蓋郵件、會議、文件寫作與試算表：檢查你是否知道什麼要先交代、什麼要人來核對。80 分通過。
intro.en: Covers email, meetings, documents and spreadsheets: do you know what to state up front and what people must verify? Pass at 80.

q.zh: 請 Claude 草擬郵件前，最該先交代哪些資訊？
q.en: Before asking Claude to draft an email, what should you state first?

why.zh: 收件人、目的與語氣是草擬前最關鍵的三項資訊。
why.en: Recipient, purpose and tone are the three most important inputs.

q.zh: 連接 Gmail 或 Outlook 讓 Claude 協助寄信時，較穩妥的做法是？
q.en: When connecting Gmail or Outlook so Claude can help send mail, what is safer?

opts.zh: 寄出前先預覽並由你核准

why.zh: 草稿不是定稿；收件人、事實、附件、敏感資料與語氣都要先檢查。
why.en: A draft is not final; check recipient, facts, attachments, sensitive data and tone first.

q.zh: 使用錄音與逐字稿整理會議前，必須先做什麼？
q.en: What must you do before recording and transcribing a meeting?

opts.en: Upload it to a public site

why.zh: 錄音與逐字稿涉及隱私，需事先取得與會者同意。
why.en: Recording and transcripts affect privacy, so get consent beforehand.

q.zh: 一份完整的「行動項目」至少應包含哪些欄位？
q.en: What fields should a complete action item include?

opts.zh: 事項、負責人、期限與狀態
opts.en: Task, owner, due date and status

why.zh: 事項、負責人、期限與狀態，缺一不可，會後才追蹤得到。
why.en: Task, owner, due date and status are all needed for follow-up.

q.zh: 寫長文件時，較有效率的順序是？
q.en: What is a more efficient order when writing a long document?

opts.zh: 先排大綱、確認方向，再生成初稿
opts.en: Outline and confirm direction first, then draft

opts.zh: 直接要完整篇，不滿意再整篇重來
opts.en: Ask for the whole piece and redo it all if unhappy

why.zh: 大綱定好方向，初稿才不容易寫偏，也比整篇重來省時間。
why.en: A settled outline keeps drafts on track and saves redoing the whole piece.

q.zh: Claude 初稿裡缺少的資訊（例如沒提供的扭力值），較合適的處理是？
q.en: How should missing information (e.g. a torque value you never supplied) be handled in a draft?

opts.zh: 請 Claude 自行編一個合理的數字
opts.en: Let Claude invent a plausible number

opts.zh: 標成待補，由熟悉設備的人核對補上
opts.en: Mark it as pending and have someone who knows the equipment fill it in

why.zh: 缺少的資訊應標出，不要讓 AI 編造；SOP 與數值由負責人核對後才發布。
why.en: Missing information should be flagged, not invented; the owner verifies SOPs and values before release.

q.zh: 匯出的感測資料有日期格式不一、空白與重複列，請 Claude 清理時較好的做法是？
q.en: Exported sensor data has mixed dates, blanks and duplicates. What is a good way to have Claude clean it?

opts.zh: 保留原始檔，讓 Claude 先列出問題與處理規則，由你確認
opts.en: Keep the original; have Claude list problems and rules first, and confirm them

why.zh: 原始檔另存、規則先確認，缺值標記而不是自行填數。
why.en: Keep the original, confirm the rules, and flag missing values rather than filling them in.

q.zh: Claude 從資料中提出「C 機中班稼動率偏低可能因換線時間拉長」，這應該被視為？
q.en: Claude says Machine C's low mid-shift utilization may come from longer changeovers. How should you treat this?

opts.zh: 待驗證的假設，要回到原始資料與現場確認
opts.en: A hypothesis to verify against raw data and on site

opts.zh: 與資料無關的猜測，可忽略

why.zh: AI 給的是假設與建議；是否成立要抽查資料並由現場人員確認，設備動作仍由人員決定。
why.en: AI offers hypotheses and suggestions; spot-check data and let on-site staff confirm. People still decide equipment actions.
